comment: Commons files that Wikidata lists as a university's logo but are not one, found by reviewing contact sheets of the build output. scripts/build-logos.mjs never uses them.

files.File:CUG State Key Laboratories.jpg: photo of a laboratory building (China University of Geosciences)
files.File:Logo-Editorial-Universidad-Icesi.pn: logo of the university's publishing house, not the university (Universidad ICESI)
files.File:ҚазҰПУ .jpg: photo of a campus building (Abai Kazakh National Pedagogical University)
files.File:Motto of Nanjing University .jpg: the university's motto in calligraphy, not its logo
